headline: Discovering Newtown Connecticut
subhead: Explore local parks, historic landmarks, and scenic trails across the area.
caption: Newtown, Connecticut offers a wonderful blend of natural beauty and historic charm across the Greater Danbury area. As November arrives, residents enjoy crisp walks along the trails at Newtown Forest Association properties and scenic views around Lake Zoar. The vibrant downtown area features local shops and historic architecture centered around the flagpole. For commuters, the town provides convenient access via Interstate 84 and Route 25. Seasonal community events bring people together throughout the autumn months, making it a great time to explore all that Newtown has to offer. Reach out to Jaskaran Singh, REALTOR® with Vylla Home, to ask for the numbers on a home in Newtown today.

scenes.label: Outdoors
scenes.title: Newtown Forest Association
scenes.detail: The Newtown Forest Association maintains over a thousand acres of preserved open space and public trails.
scenes.say: I love walking the peaceful public trails maintained by the Newtown Forest Association.

scenes.label: Landmarks
scenes.title: Historic Flagpole
scenes.detail: The iconic flagpole stands right in the center of the main downtown intersection.
scenes.say: The historic flagpole sits right at the heart of our vibrant downtown area.

scenes.label: Waterfront
scenes.title: Lake Zoar
scenes.detail: Lake Zoar sits along the Housatonic River border, offering scenic waterfront views and recreational spaces.
scenes.say: You can catch great views along the Housatonic River down by Lake Zoar.

scenes.label: Commute
scenes.title: Highway Access
scenes.detail: Interstate 84 and Route 25 intersect through town for straightforward regional travel.
scenes.say: Getting around is pretty straightforward with Interstate 84 running right through town.
